whatIsProvenBeforeTheRefusal: The private reason reaches the server: expect(committed.request().postDataJSON().reason).toBe(reason) passes on the line above the failing one.
The correction lease admits the named head, digest and generation: the refusal is raised downstream of the lease acquisition.

rootCause.summary: Under the journal fixture arm the combat stream is journaled with journal-native event ids, but the rewind commit verifies the candidate path through the MATCH STORE, which carries a parallel line with different event ids and digests for the same revisions. The candidate anchor can therefore never match.

seams.fact: reader: matchStoreBranchSegmentReader(input.store) - unconditional; there is no journal-mode branch in the deps builder.
requireBaseEvent selects event_id/event_digest from event_journal_events on the parent branch, so the candidate anchors to the JOURNAL's event.
The reader re-derives every event id from the match store row and every digest via matchEventChainDigest, so the anchor materializeBranchPath carries forward is the match store line.
materializeBranchPath compares segment.baseEventId/baseDigest against that anchor and raises the observed message.

journalBranchSegmentReader, the only journal-backed reader that exists, refuses every branch but 'root'; the armed combat stream is on 'main' (MATCH_BASELINE_BRANCH_ID, src/lib/multiplayer/server/matchAuthorityBaseline.ts:59), so it cannot simply be swapped in.

candidateRow.note: The candidate agrees with the journal, not with the match store.

matchStoreRow.note: Same revision, a different event id. This inequality is the refusal: no digest arithmetic is needed to show it.

findingsReportedNotFixed.whyTheRowWasNotChanged: The letter of E2E-25 is 'WHEN the GM finalizes a correction with a private reason ... THEN player views SHALL show the authorized result while only the GM private record contains the private detail'. The finalize genuinely refuses, so the letter is not satisfiable today. Narrowing the row to what a refused commit can prove would narrow the letter; marking it test.fail(...@until-journal-cutover) would convert a live product refusal into an expected failure, which the pack header itself forbids. The row is left as a strict failure.
findingsReportedNotFixed.requiredNextAction: The parent parks U2b again with a packet naming this gap, or re-owns E2E-25 to the journal cutover. A separately owned product unit must give the GM rewind commit a segment reader that serves the journal line for a non-'root' live-path branch, so a candidate anchored on journal ids verifies against journal ids. E2E-19 is ready to ship on its own.

findingsReportedNotFixed.detail: src/pages-modules/multiplayer/useGmCorrectionProducers.ts:19-28 still reads 'NOT YET DELIVERED - the transport DROPS the field'.
